pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.1.2: athakho mahāpajāpati gotamī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā adhovāte aṭṭhāsi
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.1.5: ādiyantu kho bhikkhuniyo udakasuddhikanti mahāpajāpatiṃ gotamiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.1.6: athakho mahāpajāpatī gotamī bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā bhagavantaṃ avivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.1.7: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.2: bhagavatā udakasuddhikā anuññātāti atigambhīraṃ udakasuddhikaṃ ādiyantī muttakaraṇe vaṇaṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.3: athakho sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.4: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.5: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī atigambhīraṃ udakasuddhikaṃ ādiyissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.6: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhunī atigambhīraṃ udakasuddhikaṃ ādiyatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.9: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhunī atigambhīraṃ udakasuddhikaṃ ādiyissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.11: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.12.1: udakasuddhikaṃ pana bhikkhuniyā ādiyamānāya dvaṅgulapabbaparamaṃ ādātabbaṃ taṃ atikkāmentiyā pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:2.1.8: samphassaṃ sādiyantī antamaso kesaggamattaṃpi atikkāmeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
